verdict.rationale: LocalAI is an inference server and platform, not purely an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. All of the MCP evidence is client-side: LocalAI connects its models and agents to external MCP servers. Nothing documents LocalAI itself exposing an MCP server endpoint for outside agents to connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
